_about: Public-domain Orestes A. Brownson (1803-1876, American Catholic convert, philosopher and controversialist) for the Word Hoard: the twenty volumes of his Works, collected by his son Henry F. Brownson (Detroit, 1882-1887), and four first editions: New Views (1836), The Spirit-Rapper (1854), The Convert (1857) and The American Republic (1866), all from Internet Archive scans. Written in English. Not the hf-brownson shelf, which holds his son's translations of Balmes. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 28 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
